lines.trans: The revamp plan for the new season of Twelve Singers is truly great; once produced, it will refresh the market as another smash hit.
Yet every side is very conservative right now, and the agencies for several big stars refuse to cooperate.
You are Xingtian's expert in artist management—do you see any way forward?
Talent agencies judge everything by commercial value, so arguing any other angle definitely will not get through.
I think you can bypass the agencies and approach a star directly.
Which artist are you referring to?
Huimei, of course—she is the single trump card in our hand.
Counting on her influence, pulling this off is genuinely possible.
However, as talent director of the management department, it is awkward for me to ask her directly; I hope you understand.
Must we really go beg Huimei? Is there truly no other way?
Xiaogu, do you have some hesitation when it comes to Huimei?
Not at all; to clear away the obstacles to the revamp, I will go back and think carefully.
Keep at it!
